Specification: This module is a lightweight typedef module that documents a collection of type aliases for a distributed protocol or algorithm using structured comments. The comments define aliases such as PROCESS, VALUE, STEP, ROUND, ACTION, TRACE, and several record-shaped message types including PROPMESSAGE, PREMESSAGE, and MESSAGE. The only actual TLA+ definition in the module is a trivial operator asserting TRUE, so the module serves as documentation-oriented type metadata rather than an executable transition-system specification and it contains no fault model, variables, actions, or temporal properties.
